name: TurnNavigator
description:
Jump between prompts on wide screens: a column of dashes beside the log, one per turn.
The current turn is the accent dash; neighbours of the pointer grow so the target is easy
to hit. Each dash names its prompt in a tooltip; arrow keys, Home and End move.
signature: ({ turns, active, onNavigate }: { turns: TurnAnchor[]; active: number; onNavigate: (index: number) => void; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current destination or active choice.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Event callback; the typed signature specifies its arguments.

props.name: turns
props.description: Conversation turns represented by the view.
